description:
A rare opportunity to acquire a stunning, unique family home overlooking Oysterhaven Bay with fabulous, uninterrupted waterfront views. Oysterhaven is situated just a short drive from the towns of Kinsale and Carrigaline. This detached residence is set on 2 acres, offering breathtaking water views of Oysterhaven Bay and the surrounding countryside. Its elevated position ensures plenty of natural light throughout the day.

The property, approximately 247 sq m (2,658.69 sq.ft), features a very generous open-plan living room, dining area, study, and kitchen, creating a seamless flow throughout. It boasts a high vaulted ceiling with Scandinavian timber roof beams. The property's style and design are unique and complemented by a high-energy performance BER Cert with a very high Green Rating of B. It includes underfloor heating with a heat pump, three spacious double bedrooms (including a master en-suite), a family bathroom, and an indoor hot tub. Outside, the property benefits from a spacious 40 sq m detached garage and a large steel shed for extra storage.

Built in 2002, this property is exceptionally modern. If open-plan living is your preference, this house will not disappoint; it offers a fabulous sense of space while remaining warm and comfortable. There is also ample room for potential further extensions if desired.

Location:
Oysterhaven is only a 10-minute drive from the charming seaside town of Kinsale. It is also just a 20-minute drive to the vibrant city of Cork. This area of South West Ireland is outstanding, renowned for its dramatic coastline, unspoiled locations, and safe beaches. Leisure activities are well catered for, and Oysterhaven / Kinsale provides excellent sailing, yachting, and fishing facilities from its two marinas. There are three world-class golf courses, including the renowned Old Head of Kinsale. Other recreational pursuits include walking, bathing, surfing, and horse riding. There are numerous cultural events held throughout the year, such as the world-famous Kinsale Arts Festival, the Cork Jazz Festival, Cork Film Festival, and Kinsale Gourmet Festival, along with a thriving music and opera programme.

Cork has several fine theatres, and Cork Opera House hosts many exceptional productions yearly. Kinsale is also home to some of Ireland's finest restaurants, contributing to its title as Gourmet Capital of Ireland; along with many top-class hotels and lots of welcoming pubs. Cork International Airport is conveniently located 20 minutes drive from Kinsale with direct links within Ireland and to Major European and UK cities.
